# Century (thecentury.in)

> Century is a food brand by Dinero FoodWorks Pvt. Ltd. (DFPL), Nawanshahr, Punjab, India. It sells soya chunks, makhana (fox nuts), unpolished pulses, besan (gram flour), poha (flattened rice), jaggery powder and single-serve sachets for homes and HoReCa (hotels, restaurants and cafés). The company's manufacturing units are FSSC 22000 certified.

## Products
- Soya Chunks: Soya Chunks, Soya Jumbo, Soya Granules and Soya Mini
- Makhana (fox nuts): Classic Select, Puffed and Mini
- Pulses: masoor, moong, toor, chana, kabuli chana, rajma (Chitra), lobiya and mixed dal, in 500 g and 1 kg packs
- Besan (gram flour)
- Poha (flattened rice)
- Jaggery Powder (500 g)
- Seasonings: chilli and oregano
